name: venue-control-agent
description: On-site agent for TSB Platform's Venue Control. Phase 0: registration, config pull, heartbeat, local status UI, admin PIN. Phase 1: network discovery/diagnostics (scan, classify, test, adopt). Phase 2: DirecTV SHEF driver + poller, staff Sources tab (channel control + favorites), staff PIN. Phase 3: Samsung TV power (WS remote + SmartThings fallback + WoL) with state verification, zones, bulk/per-zone power, staff TVs tab, cron schedules evaluated in the site's own timezone. Phase 4: TV source (QAM channel) selection via remote key codes, per-TV and bulk, from the staff TVs tab. Phase 5: whole-room layouts (capture-current-state, tap-to-apply with 15s undo), backup/restore, activity log. Phase 6: Roku ECP driver (apps, launch, keypress), spare/static slot handling -- see docs/venue-control.md in the main repo. All six build-order phases are now complete.
